module.description: The import module (`solid-js`, `node:fs`), `lib` for TypeScript's built-in lib.*.d.ts, `global` for a bare global, or a Python package.

name.description: An exported name (`createSignal`). A trailing `*` matches a prefix.

member.description: `Type.method` for a method on an instance (`Session.get`, `Array.find`). A trailing `*` matches a prefix.

args.description: Which arguments the model is about: `0`, `1`, `*` (the default) or `this` for the receiver.

returns.description: What the call yields: `callback` is what the callback at `args` returns.

source.description: For `calls-back`: the argument whose value (or return) the callback's first parameter receives.

accessor.description: For `calls-back`: the call makes an accessor, and calling it yields the callback's return.

option.description: For `calls-back`: the options key that holds the callback (`queryFn`).

lazy.description: For `state-pair`: a function initial value is called, and what it returns seeds the state (`useState(() => …)`).

writes.description: For `consumes`: the receiver keeps the arguments (`push`, `set`).

proof.description: The proof kind its relations carry, so existing proof names survive.

note.description: One line for the code map and the proof detail.
